title.en: Splitting heaven and earth with an AI axe — the birth of VocabSummit
title.zh: 挥舞AI之斧开天辟地 —— 词山学海的创作现场

venue.en: Workshop conducted for the 2026 AI in Sec CL NLC, a networked learning community of 8 teachers from 16 schools across 13 clusters
venue.zh: 为「2026 AI in Sec CL NLC」举办的工作坊。该学习社群由来自 13 个学区、16 所学校的 8 名教师组成

summary.en: How VocabSummit actually got built: what it looks like when a teacher with no coding background designs and ships a working product in conversation with an AI agent.
summary.zh: 词山学海是怎么做出来的：一个没有编码背景的教师，怎么跟 AI agent 一起，把一个真正能用的东西做出来。

title.en: When Learning Becomes a Mountain You Want to Climb — Motivation by Design in Self-Directed Learning
title.zh: 当学习成为一座你愿意攀登的山 —— 自主学习中的动机设计

venue.en: Sharing with BVSS SPMC, the School Planning and Management Committee of Bukit View Secondary School
venue.zh: 面向百德中学校务规划与管理委员会（BVSS SPMC）的分享

summary.en: A sharing for school and teacher leaders on designing self-directed learning so that motivation is built into the structure rather than expected from students.
summary.zh: 面向校方与教师领导的分享：自主学习要怎么设计，才能把动机放进结构里，而不是指望学生自己有。

title.en: If ancient philosophers were alive today, how would they advise us?
title.zh: 古代哲学家若穿越到现代，会如何给我们提供人生建议？

venue.en: Post shared with SgLDC, the Singapore Learning Designers Circle: a group of over 22,000 educators run by MOE's Educational Technology Division, for teachers designing technology-enabled learning
venue.zh: 在新加坡学习设计师社群（SgLDC）发布的分享贴文。该社群由教育部教育技术司（ETD）主办，成员逾两万两千人，面向设计科技辅助学习的教师

summary.en: A Secondary 4 Higher Chinese lesson from the Chapter 2 Cultural Station. Students play a hawker deciding whether to raise prices as costs climb, then think it through with Confucius, Laozi and Mozi, each built as a chatbot in EdCafe.AI and delivered through SLS. They pick which one to consult, defend that school of thought in the hot seat, then weigh all three to justify a decision.
summary.zh: 中四高级华文单元二文化站的课例。学生扮演一个小贩：成本上涨，要不要涨价？然后分别去问孔子、老子、墨子。三位思想家用 EdCafe.AI 做成聊天机器人，通过 SLS 推送。学生自己选想请教谁，坐上「热座」替那一家辩护，最后综合三家，给出自己的决定。

award.en: SgLDC Designer Badge, awarded by ETD
award.zh: SgLDC Designer Badge · 教育技术司（ETD）颁发

label.en: SLS Community Gallery: Sec 4 HCL Chapter 2 Cultural Station
label.zh: SLS 社群展示馆：中四高华单元二文化站

title.en: A Doraemon's pocket for Chinese Language Learning — Bukit View Secondary School Chinese Language Resource Hub
title.zh: 中学华文的百宝袋 —— 百德中学华文资源站

venue.en: Post shared with SgLDC, the Singapore Learning Designers Circle: a group of over 22,000 educators run by MOE's Educational Technology Division, for teachers designing technology-enabled learning
venue.zh: 在新加坡学习设计师社群（SgLDC）发布的分享贴文。该社群由教育部教育技术司（ETD）主办，成员逾两万两千人，面向设计科技辅助学习的教师

summary.en: On building the school's Chinese Language resource hub, and why the structure transfers to any subject: students reach for their devices anyway, so the device may as well hold what they need. A shared hub also turns out to be an easy thing for colleagues to start adding to.
summary.zh: 讲校内华文资源站是怎么建起来的，以及这套做法为什么换个科目也用得上：学生卡住时本来就会去拿设备，那就让设备里有他们要的东西。而一个共用的平台，同事也比较容易开始往里面加。

award.en: SgLDC Connector Badge for EdTech insights and tools, July 2026, awarded by ETD
award.zh: SgLDC Connector Badge · 教育科技洞见与工具类别 · 2026年7月 · 教育技术司（ETD）颁发
